bead.title: bench-pr-A1d: runtime-probe.sh for 6 model-server backends
bead.description:
PROBLEM: There is no host-side bash probe to capture which model server actually served a sweep, so cell reports cannot record model_server provenance without Python. We need a shell runtime-probe that, given a profile, curls the backend and emits a model_server record.

ROOT CAUSE: No scripts/benchmark/runtime-probe.sh exists in the shell contract; model-server identity is implicit in the host-Python path — cmd/bench/matrix.go forwards FIZEAU_BASE_URL/FIZEAU_MODEL via --ae and process env (around runMatrixHarbor, ~lines 1117-1129) but never probes the server for its identity. Backends to support: lucebox, llamacpp, vllm, omlx, ds4, rapid-mlx.

PROPOSED FIX:
- scripts/benchmark/runtime-probe.sh: '# SUMMARY:' header; reads profile JSON on stdin; cases on profile.metadata.runtime (lucebox | llamacpp | vllm | omlx | ds4 | rapid-mlx, with lucebox-*/llama-server accepted as aliases); curl + jq the runtime's HTTP endpoint (profile.provider.base_url), one arm each; emits a model_server JSON record {name, version, commit, endpoint}. Documented exit codes: 0 reachable+record, 3 unreachable+record(status=unreachable), 2 malformed input/missing endpoint.

NON-SCOPE: harbor-runner Docker image + build script (sibling A1a); shell harness-adapters + their listing/contract (sibling A1b); task-executors/harbor wrapper + its listing/contract (sibling A1c); runner dispatch/--plan/matrix expansion (A2); per-cell execution loop, resume/retry, report compose (A3); concurrency/signals/budget (A4); Go changes, deactivation, parity (A5); cell-report.schema.json (PR B); tasks_from/task_executor bench-set schema (PR C); Node collector (PR D); Node importers (PR E); deleting cmd/bench (PR F); docs (PR G).

DEPENDENCY: parent fizeau-163efede. Fully independent — no sibling deps. Governing artifact: plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

ACCEPTANCE:
1. runtime-probe.sh emits a model_server JSON record {name, version, commit, endpoint} for each of the 6 backends from a captured endpoint fixture. Test: Test_RuntimeProbe_lucebox, Test_RuntimeProbe_vllm (scripts/benchmark/tests/runtime_probe.bats).
Gates: go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit both pass.
bead.acceptance: runtime-probe.sh emits model_server JSON for all 6 backends from fixtures (Test_RuntimeProbe_lucebox, Test_RuntimeProbe_vllm); go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit green.
